zones.text: Merseyside Police recorded 254 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — an average of 5.6 per 1,000 residents a month, the 25th highest rate of Liverpool's 30 wards. Those two scores are split by offence type, not by clock time — the police feed records no time of day, so day and night here mean the kinds of crime typical of each, not counts of incidents observed then. Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.
